title: fix(types,core): one authority for ActionContext (objectui#6349, batch 4)
body:
Refs #6349 (batch 4)
Clause-②: yes

Batch 4 of the one-authority burn-down: the three `core` and `types` rows of `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` (`ActionContext`, `ActionResult`, `ComponentMeta`). **All three rows converge here.** `ActionContext` converged in the first round. `ActionResult` and `ComponentMeta` were stop-and-report in the first round (measured below). The seat's claim amendment `6077155250` answered them (ActionResult **A1**, ComponentMeta **A**), and the second round converged both (the dev's addendum `6077857371`; summary in the next section). Types only: the emitted JavaScript of both packages is byte-identical to the base.

Notation: REC means `Record` keyed by `string` with `any` values. Generic arguments are spelled in words because GitHub strips angle-bracket spans from bodies.


## Round 2: the amendment, converged (head `7fc6d14e`)

- **Ledger:** `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` had 28 rows at base and has 25 at head. The gate is 11 of 11.
  - Stale legs on `ActionResult` and `ComponentMeta` read `no longer collides at:`, naming both files.
  - Fresh legs on `ActionResult`, `ComponentMeta` and the moved `UndoableOperation` read `a NEW colliding name`.
- **`ActionResult` (A1):** `@object-ui/types` is the one declaration.
  - It gains the runner's `reload`, `redirect`, `modal`, `silent` and `undo`, and its unread `refresh` is retired.
  - `UndoableOperation` moves into `ui-action.ts` and is published from the types entry. It needs no core-only type.
  - core's `ActionRunner.ts` re-exports `ActionResult`, and `UndoManager.ts` imports and re-exports `UndoableOperation`.
- **`ComponentMeta` (A):** core's derived declaration is renamed `RegistryComponentMeta`, and core's `ComponentMeta` re-exports types'.
  - `register`, `registerLazy`, `getMeta` and the registry's internal readers use the new name, and `PluginScopeImpl.ts` imports it.
  - The derivation pin is re-aimed, and it gains a pin that core's `ComponentMeta` is the canonical one.
  - The three `ComponentMeta['labelling']` readers (fields `index.tsx`, app-shell `widgets.tsx`, `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`) read `RegistryComponentMeta['labelling']`.
- **Published surface, one program per tree:**
  - core's `ActionResult` and `UndoableOperation` keep identical members.
  - core's `ComponentMeta` loses exactly `deprecated`, `labelling`, `namespace`, `skipFallback` and `tier`, and core's `RegistryComponentMeta` equals the old one.
  - types' `ActionResult` gains five members and loses `refresh`.
  - Exported names only grow: core 512 → 513 (`RegistryComponentMeta`), types 710 → 711 (`UndoableOperation`).
  - Emitted JS is byte-identical for types, fields and app-shell. In core it differs in one JSDoc line in `registry/Registry.js`, with a code-only diff of 0.
- **Consumer impact:** 15 of 15 type-checks exit 0: types, core, react, sdui-parser, fields, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report, plugin-timeline, components, app-shell, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, plugin-view, plugin-designer and console. They cover every package that names these types or drives an `ActionRunner`.
- **Suites:**
  - types + core + the gate: 566 files and 14,054 tests passed;
  - fields: 242 files and 3,956 tests passed;
  - app-shell, narrowed to the 37 files that import the two changed modules: 550 tests passed. Its emitted JS is unchanged, and CI runs the full suite.
- **Changesets:** `minor` on types, core, fields and app-shell, each with a breaking-change note. ⛔ No `major`.
## `ActionContext`: converged on `@object-ui/types`

| member | `core` (`ActionRunner.ts`, before) | `types` (`ui-action.ts`, before) | the one declaration (after) |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `data` | optional REC | none (index signature, so `any`) | **optional REC** (core's member moves down) |
| `record` | optional `any` | optional REC | optional REC |
| `selectedRecords` | optional REC array | same | same |
| `pageVariables` | optional REC | same | same |
| `user` | optional `any` | optional REC | optional REC |
| index signature | string key to `any` | same | same |

- **One concept, drifted copies.** Both are the runner's execution data bag. `@object-ui/types` is the dependency-legal authority: it has no `@object-ui/*` dependency, and `core` depends on it. `ActionRunner.ts` now RE-EXPORTS it (`export type { ActionContext } from '@object-ui/types'`), and its row leaves the ledger.
- **`data` moved down** because the runner reads it: as the fallback record id in `executeForm`, and as the API request body in `buildApiRequestBody`. **`record` / `user` keep the narrower REC**, because every package below compiles against it.
- **Consumers, enumerated before reshaping.** Name importers: 33 import sites of `ActionContext` point at `@object-ui/core` and 7 point at `ActionRunner` relatively, against 2 of the `@object-ui/types` copy (its barrel, and one `action-group-retired` lit control). Implicit users drive an `ActionRunner` without naming the type. `pnpm --filter PKG type-check` is green on 15 packages against the converged shape, with `types` and `core` dist rebuilt first: types, core, react, sdui-parser, fields, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report, plugin-timeline, components, app-shell, plugin-grid, plugin-detail, plugin-view, plugin-designer and console. All 15 read exit 0 with zero `error TS` lines, and each run echoed its script name. The same set was exit 0 at base.

### Published surface, read off the BUILT entry declarations
- An acceptance probe compiled against each tree's `dist/index.d.ts`, with predictions written first. All matched.
  - **Identity** of core's and types' `ActionContext`: base `TS2322` (two types), head clean (one type).
  - **Narrowings, on base and head:**
    - core's `record` given a string: base clean, head `TS2322`.
    - core's `user` given a string: base clean, head `TS2322`.
    - types' `data` given a string: base clean, head `TS2322`.
  - **Controls:**
    - An object-shaped context compiles on both trees.
    - The negative control (`selectedRecords` given a string) is `TS2322` on both trees, at the same columns.
- **Exported name sets are unchanged.** Enumerated through the type checker over `dist/index.d.ts`: core 512 = 512 and types 710 = 710, with zero diff lines.
- **Emitted JS is byte-identical**: core 107 of 107 files and types 74 of 74.
- **Declaration diffs:**
  - core: exactly `actions/ActionRunner.d.ts`.
  - types: `ui-action.d.ts` (+311 tokens, 0 removed: the docblock and `data`).
  - types: 15 `zod/*.d.ts` files read different, but every one is token-multiset-equal. That is literal-union member ORDER between a cached base build and a fresh head build, not content.
- **Grade:** `minor` for both packages, because a member type narrows on each (objectui never declares `major`). The breaking semantics are written into both changesets.

## `ActionResult`: round 1's stop, answered A1 by amendment `6077155250` (the measurement that led there)

| member | `core` | `types` |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `success`, `data`, `error`, `close` | yes | yes |
| `reload` | yes | no |
| `redirect` | optional `string` | no |
| `modal` | optional `any` | no |
| `silent` | yes | no |
| `undo` | optional `UndoableOperation` (declared in core's `UndoManager.ts`) | no |
| `refresh` | no | yes (in-repo readers and writers found: none) |

One concept, the result of executing an action, but the only legal direction cannot carry `undo`. Two probes, both run with the mutation proven on disk and restored under a trap (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
- **R1, a re-point at today's `types` shape.** `core` `tsc --noEmit` exits 2 with 20 errors, every one on a core-only member: `redirect` ×7, `reload` ×7, `undo` ×4, `modal` ×1, `silent` ×1.
- **R2, a widened authority.** `types` gains `reload` / `redirect` / `modal` / `silent`, plus `undo` typed `unknown`, the most `types` can say without reaching core. The `types` and `core` dist were rebuilt inside the trap, and the probe marker read 1 in `types/dist`. The core build itself fails. The `tsconfig.test.json` legs read: core src 1 error, core tests 17, app-shell tests 9. **All 27 are reads of `undo` as an `UndoableOperation`**: the runner's `globalUndoManager.push(result.undo)`, plus tests reading `undoData` / `redoData` / `objectName`. The restore leg rebuilt and read the marker at 0.

So the one blocker is that `UndoableOperation` lives in `core`. Converging means declaring it in `@object-ui/types`, which is a new published name, and having `UndoManager.ts` re-export it. Both are outside this claim, so the row stays in the ledger.

## `ComponentMeta`: round 1's stop, answered A by amendment `6077155250` (the measurement that led there)

`core`'s is `CanonicalComponentMeta & RegistryComponentMetaExtras`: `types`' declaration plus five registry-only keys (`tier`, `namespace`, `skipFallback`, `labelling`, `deprecated`). That is a different, narrower meaning, registration metadata, so the card's remedy is the rename branch. A rename probe was run, with `core` dist rebuilt inside the trap (marker present) and rebuilt again on restore (marker 0). It renamed core's declaration to `RegistryComponentMeta` and re-pointed `@object-ui/core`'s `ComponentMeta` at `types`. The breaks, all outside this claim's files:
- fields `src/index.tsx`: 1, `TS2339` on `ComponentMeta['labelling']`;
- app-shell `widgets.tsx` and `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`: 2, the same read;
- core `component-meta-derives-from-canonical.test.ts`: 8, the derivation pin;
- sdui-parser, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report and plugin-timeline: 0.

`@object-ui/core`'s published `ComponentMeta` would lose five keys, which is a reshaped published name. The row stays in the ledger.

## Verification, round 1 (commit `9495823c2`; round 2's readings are above)
- **The gate is green** (`scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, 11 of 11). Its ledger had 28 rows at base and 27 after round 1, and has 25 at head after round 2. The re-derivation instrument is the test itself.
- **Gate non-vacuity**, mutations proven and restored by state:
  - Stale leg: re-adding the `ActionContext` row reads `1 failed | 10 passed` with `ActionContext — no longer collides at:` naming both files.
  - Fresh leg: re-declaring it in `ActionRunner.ts` reads `ActionContext — a NEW colliding name` with both sites.
  - The first stale attempt was refused by `ablation-replace` (its replacement contained its own anchor), so it ran nothing. It was redone with a non-overlapping anchor.
- **The moved pin.** `actionKeys.pin.test.ts` now reads `ActionContext`'s index signature off `ui-action.ts`. Ablating the signature there reads `ActionContext: false` (red), and the restore is proven.
- **Root-form vitest on `packages/types/` + `packages/core/` + the gate**, run at `84f668973`: 565 of 566 files. The one failure was the pin above, which read the runner module; it was repaired in `9495823c2`. At `9495823c2`, the three changed or affected test files read 32 of 32.
- **`type-check` (hyphenated, script echoed):** types and core are exit 0. Core's `tsconfig.test.json` is exit 0 at `9495823c2`, and `--listFiles` includes the pin file. `type-check:scripts` is exit 0 and covers the ledger file.
- **Other gates:** `eslint` on the 4 touched files has 0 errors (22 warnings, 27 at base). `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, changeset presence and no-major are all exit 0. The governed-queue guard reads NOT GOVERNED.
- **Declared narrowings:**
  - The verify lock was held by other worktrees for most of an hour (repeated queue-timeouts). The final-commit runs of the core test type-check, `type-check:scripts` and the three test files therefore ran outside the lock, on a shared box.
  - The full `types` + `core` suite was not re-run at `9495823c2`. The only delta since `84f668973` is the one test file, which was run alone.
  - Downstream type-check covers 15 of the 38 packages that depend on `core`: the name importers plus every package that drives an `ActionRunner`. CI runs the rest.
- **Eager first-load bytes:** not affected, because no emitted JS moved.

## Acceptance notes
- `types`' `ActionResult.refresh` has no in-repo reader or writer: the runner reads `reload`. A handler typed against the `types` copy that sets `refresh` is ignored at runtime. This belongs to the `ActionResult` decision above, not to this PR.
- `ActionExecutor` (in `ui-action.ts`) has no implementer and no importer outside its own barrel. It is an observation only.
